digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch alarms and SNS notification routing (infra/terraform)
propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing OK→ALARM transitions to notify nobody despite being wired to functional metrics.

The silent-alarm pattern violates the repo's own stated convention: 11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn, while these two omit them entirely.

The voter_errors alarm's contract (monitoring_s4b.tf header) claims it surfaces broken voter state to operators, but the resource omits notification configuration, leaving the LLM-Review safety net silent to production.

A guard test was added to prevent future alarms from shipping mute: it parses all alarm blocks under infra/terraform/, fails on any lacking alarm_actions, includes anti-vacuity assertions (>= 13 blocks), and requires explicit opt-out markers for intentional silence.

The HCL fix (adding actions to both alarms and updating monitoring_1fa8.tf's misleading comment) was merged to main at 24ec1e6d8a but did not apply to AWS; live describe-alarms remained at AlarmActions: [] until terraform apply was executed by an operator.
